title: Metric view listings are generally available in Databricks Marketplace
body: Providers can publish governed business metrics in Databricks Marketplace by adding metric views. Only Databricks recipients can use shared metric views. See [Create a Marketplace listing](/aws/en/marketplace/create-listing) and [Add metric views to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#metric-views).

ref_links.text: Add metric views to a share
